$comment: Coverage floors and the settings that decide what each floor measures. This file is the source of truth; each manifest below carries a copy that its test runner reads, and scripts/check-coverage-thresholds-sync.ts fails when a copy differs. jest.<package> mirrors the jest block of <package>/package.json. pytest.agent.run and .report mirror [tool.coverage.run] and [tool.coverage.report] in agent/pyproject.toml, whole, and give the coverage flags of the test task in agent/mise.toml. Raise a floor when coverage improves; do not lower a floor or narrow a scope without maintainer approval. Floors measured 2026-06-02.
